inputs.share_count_basis: 1,200.44m ordinary shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (interim note 20(a), after 21.1m repurchased in H1 and net of 38.5m treasury shares) plus 4.58m dilutive RSUs/options from the interim diluted-EPS table = 1,205.0m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. The US$550m Equity Linked Securities are cash-settled with an exercise price of US$8.28/share (~HK$65) against the current HKEX price (see current_price), so they are treated as debt at face, not as dilution.
inputs.debt_composition: RMB m at 2026-06-30: bank loans 5,171.4 (3,862.8 non-current + 1,308.6 current; 3,227.0 secured on the Yonghui stake at 2.72-2.80%, 1,158.0 secured on the HQ land-use right) + letter-of-credit borrowings 1,042.3 + NCI shareholder loans 4.3 + Equity Linked Securities at face 3,953.3 (US$550m, 0.5% coupon, due Jan-2032; carrying liability 2,422.9 + embedded-derivative liability 858.7 = 3,281.6, but the company owes principal in cash at maturity so face is used) + TOP TOY Series A preferred-share redemption liability 602.7 = 10,774.0. Cash = cash and equivalents 7,046.9 + term deposits 241.1 = 7,288.0; restricted cash (5.9), the call-spread derivative asset (321.9, out of the money) and other investments (579.5) are excluded as conservative omissions. Lease liabilities 4,577.8 are EXCLUDED (treatment B below).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report opex-by-nature note, 'Equity-settled share-based payment expenses' RMB367,869k (9896.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:360). No net-share-settlement tax withholding is disclosed (Cayman/HKEX filer), so sbc_incl_equity_taxes equals the expense. H1 FY2026: RMB123.7m (1.1% of revenue).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchases RMB535.2m and H1 FY2026 RMB532.2m (financing cash flow), funded alongside RMB1,358m of FY2025 dividends while borrowings rose; the flat count is being paid for, but with debt rather than owner FCF, which was RMB210m in FY2025.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in CNY (RMB); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1754 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on 2026-10-23. Parity check against the NYSE ADR (MNSO, 1 ADS = 4 ordinary shares): US$10.04 at the 2026-10-23 NYSE close x USD/HKD 7.843 / 4 = HK$19.69 vs the HKEX close recorded in current_price at inputs.price_as_of, a 0.9% tie that confirms the rate direction and the quote basis. Per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by 1.1754 for the unsuffixed (HKD) keys.
inputs.fiscal_year_note: Year-end changed from 30 June to 31 December in 2023 (FY2024-6mo is the Jul-Dec 2023 transition stub). FY2024 and FY2025 are calendar years; H1 FY2026 is Jan-Jun 2026. Year 1 of the projection is FY2026, discounted a full period from the 2026-10-24 valuation date, which is ~10 months conservative.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. Risk-free 1.8% (10y China Government Bond, Oct-2026); equity risk premium 6.5% (mature-market 4.5% + 2.0% China country premium); beta 1.25 for an HK-listed Chinese consumer-discretionary retailer -> cost of equity 9.9%. After-tax cost of debt 2.3% (bank loans 2.7-2.8%, ELS 0.5% coupon). Weights 88/12 on market cap RMB20.3bn vs net debt RMB3.5bn (leases excluded, treated as operating cost). WACC = 0.88 x 9.9 + 0.12 x 2.3 = 9.0%. The same 9.0% is used in all three scenarios; cyclicality, the Yonghui exposure and the DTC-margin risk are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked onto the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment B, leases as operating cost. The full IFRS-16 lease payment (capital + interest element, one financing-activities line: FY2024 725.1, FY2025 897.5, H1 FY2026 551.5 = 4.2% / 4.8% of revenue) is charged inside owner EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path, and lease liabilities (RMB4,577.8m at 2026-06-30) are excluded from net debt. ebitda_margin_path is therefore the company's IFRS-16 adjusted EBITDA margin (pre-lease, pre-SBC: FY2024 25.5%, FY2025 23.1%, H1 FY2026 19.6%); da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PP&E 270.0 + intangibles ~10 = 1.3% of revenue; ROU depreciation 971.5 is NOT charged again) so cash-tax EBIT counts the lease exactly once. last_fcf of 210.4 = reported FCF 1,580.2 - SBC 367.9 - interest income 104.4 - lease payments 897.5, the same basis as the forward build.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI (RMB110.1m at 2026-06-30, mainly the 13.1% of TOP TOY not owned) deducted once in the equity bridge; flows are left consolidated because the NCI profit share is immaterial (RMB5.0m in H1 FY2026). The TOP TOY preferred shares are a redemption liability (RMB602.7m) and sit in total_debt, not in NCI.
inputs.equity_accounted_treatment: The 29.4% Yonghui Superstores stake (2,668.1m shares) is a non-operating asset: its P&L share (FY2025 loss RMB834.5m incl. impairment; H1 FY2026 profit RMB60.3m) is excluded from the flows and the stake enters the equity bridge at the fair value the company reported at 2026-06-30, RMB7,577.5m (interim note 16, quoted price basis). Today's mark is higher (RMB2.95 on 601933.SS at the 2026-10-23 close = RMB7,871m); the filed figure is used to keep the bridge on the same vintage as net debt. No block discount is applied; the bear weight carries the risk that a 29% block in a loss-making turnaround is worth less than its screen price.
inputs.mid_cycle_basis: FY2025 is not a clean base. Reported net income (RMB1,209.8m) carries the RMB834.5m Yonghui equity-accounted loss and RMB158.5m of preferred-share / derivative fair-value losses, both excluded here (adjusted net profit RMB2,898.2m). Owner FCF (RMB210m) is depressed by a RMB1,370m working-capital outflow (inventories -917, receivables -1,029, payables +576) on a RMB4,450m revenue increase, HQ-building construction capex and the directly-operated-store build-out. FY2022 capex included a one-off RMB944.1m land-use-right purchase. Rather than carry any single year's margin forward, the forward FCF is built from components with working capital modelled on the CHANGE in revenue (negative capture, inventory + receivables > payables) and capex normalising as the HQ completes.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating retailer; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US/cyclical: consumer' with the adaptations file applied for CNY/HKD currency, IFRS-16 leases, NCI and the Yonghui non-operating asset). Fresh build, no prior DCF or memory entry. MINISO is a global lifestyle-products retailer: 8,309 stores at 2026-06-30 (4,665 Chinese mainland, 3,644 overseas) plus 365 TOP TOY stores; H1 FY2026 revenue +22.4% (China +26.2% on mid-single-digit same-store GMV growth, overseas +14.9% with low-single-digit same-store decline, TOP TOY +32.7%); gross margin flat at 44.3% but selling & distribution +39.6% on directly-operated overseas stores, so adjusted EBITDA grew only 3.1% and the margin fell to 19.6% from 23.3%. The 52-week range is 16.84-44.48; the stock has derated from ~14x to ~6.5x forward earnings as two years of near-zero owner FCF, debt-funded dividends/buybacks and the Yonghui acquisition compounded with the H1 margin step-down. Interest income is stripped (RMB7.3bn of gross cash sits in the bridge). Price is a regular-session close, not after-hours.

equity_bridge.note: 9896.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:4483; its P&L share is excluded from the flows (matching-asset rule). Pledged in part (RMB3,866m carrying) against the acquisition loans already in net debt.

historical_growth.basis_note: Fiscal year-end moved from June to December in 2023, so the 'FY2022 -> FY2025' span is 3.5 years (Jun-2022 to Dec-2025) and 'FY2021 -> FY2025' is 4.5 years; CAGRs use those fractional year counts.
historical_growth.eps_note: FY2025 EPS of RMB0.98 is depressed by the Yonghui and derivative losses; adjusted net profit compounded 48.7% (FY2022 722.6 -> FY2025 2,898.2) but off a pandemic-depressed FY2022 base. FY2021 EPS was negative (-1.18), so no 5-year EPS CAGR.
historical_growth.owner_fcf_definition: OCF - capex - SBC - interest income - lease payments (capital + interest); FY2022 shown both with and without the one-off RMB944.1m land-use-right purchase, and the ex-land figure is the CAGR start point
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_3yr_cagr (12.5%), rounded; used as the mid-horizon anchor. Year-1 growth of 20% comes from the H1 FY2026 run-rate (+22.4%) decelerating, not from the historical CAGR.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (12.5%) is less than half the revenue CAGR (24.0%): equity growth is held down by a ~50% dividend payout plus buybacks, both funded by borrowings in FY2025. More importantly, the owner-FCF CAGR is NEGATIVE (-27.6% over 3.5 years; reported FCF +88%) because lease payments (+180%), SBC (+344%) and working capital absorbed all of the EBITDA growth. An increasing share of reported growth is being paid for in leases, stock and inventory.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs are computed on the SBC-, interest- and lease-adjusted series, not reported FCF. Reported FCF CAGRs are shown only to size the gap.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +20% (H1 +22.4%; H2 laps a stronger FY2025 H2 comp) then decelerating as China store growth slows and overseas moves to a partner-led model; 3.5% by year 10 against ~4-5% China nominal GDP.
base.margin_rationale: IFRS-16 adjusted EBITDA margin starts at 19.5% (H1 FY2026 19.6%, S&D +39.6% on directly-operated overseas stores) and recovers 1.5pp as those stores mature, well short of FY2024's 25.5%. Lease cost 4.9-5.0% of revenue (H1 FY2026 4.8%, rising with DTC mix). D&A ex-ROU 1.6-1.8% (FY2025 1.3% before HQ-building depreciation starts). Capex 5.8% in FY2026 (H1 6.3% with HQ construction) normalising to 2.5%. Cash tax 25% (PRC statutory; FY2025 cash tax ~23% of lease-adjusted EBIT plus dividend withholding).
base.wc_rationale: Working capital consumed 31% and 35% of the revenue increase in FY2025 and FY2024 (inventory + receivables build for the overseas DTC roll-out). H1 FY2026 released inventory. -22% is between the balance-sheet NWC ratio (11.6% of revenue) and the recent marginal rate, assuming the DTC inventory build moderates.

bull.rationale: IP-led same-store recovery in China sustained, overseas same-store turns positive as the directly-operated US/Europe stores mature, TOP TOY compounds at 30%+ and lists; margin recovers most of the way to the FY2024 level and the DTC inventory build normalises.

bear.rationale: The H1 FY2026 margin step-down is structural: directly-operated overseas stores keep absorbing S&D and rent, China same-store growth fades once the IP cycle (blind boxes, licensed collaborations) cools, and working capital keeps absorbing ~30% of incremental revenue. Growth fades to 2% and the terminal multiple is capped at 12x.

scenario_narratives.base: MINISO keeps compounding revenue at ~20% in FY2026 off H1's +22.4%, decelerating to mid-single digits by year 6-7 as the China network (4,665 stores) approaches saturation and overseas growth shifts back toward the asset-light retail-partner model. The axes that matter are (1) whether the directly-operated overseas stores that drove S&D +39.6% in H1 FY2026 mature into margin rather than remain a structural drag, (2) whether the IP strategy sustains China same-store growth, and (3) whether the inventory/receivables build (31% of incremental revenue in FY2025) normalises. The base assumes partial recovery on all three: EBITDA margin 19.5% to 21%, lease cost 5%, working-capital capture -22%, capex normalising from 5.8% to 2.5% as the Guangzhou HQ completes. Owner-FCF margin builds from ~2% in FY2026 to ~9% by year 10 as growth and the WC drag fade. The Yonghui stake sits in the bridge at the filed RMB7.58bn fair value; its operating result is not in the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: The IP-led China same-store recovery (mid-single digit in H1 FY2026) holds, overseas same-store turns positive as the directly-operated stores in the US and Europe mature, TOP TOY sustains 30%+ growth and completes its listing (crystallising value for the RMB603m preferred-share liability), and the DTC inventory build moderates to -15% capture. Adjusted EBITDA margin recovers to 23.5%, close to the FY2024 25.5% peak, and growth stays double-digit through year 5. Yonghui's turnaround (profit in H1 FY2026) would be upside to the bridge mark, not modelled.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H1 FY2026 step-down is structural, not transitional: directly-operated overseas stores keep absorbing rent and selling cost (lease cost 5.5%, EBITDA margin 17%), China same-store growth fades once the current IP cycle cools, the overseas model keeps tying up working capital at ~30% of incremental revenue, and growth decays to 2%. Owner FCF stays near the FY2025 RMB210m level for years and dividends plus buybacks continue to be debt-funded. The RMB10.8bn of gross debt-like obligations (acquisition loans secured on Yonghui, ELS due 2032, TOP TOY preferred redemption) are serviceable but constrain capital returns; the Yonghui block, carried at a quoted price for a 29% stake in a loss-making turnaround, may be worth materially less than its screen value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: owner FCF has been near zero for two consecutive years while debt rose from RMB0.6bn to RMB10.8bn, the H1 FY2026 EBITDA margin fell 3.7pp, and a quarter of total assets is a pledged stake in a loss-making supermarket turnaround; none of these is going-concern risk but together they make the downside path the one the market is currently pricing. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right (overseas DTC margin maturation, sustained China same-store growth, working-capital normalisation). Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A growth retailer valued on strict owner FCF: SBC expensed, interest income stripped, IFRS-16 lease cash charged in full, the Yonghui stake and its P&L kept out of the flows and in the bridge at the filed fair value, and the forward FCF built from components with working capital on the change in revenue because the last two years show the growth consuming the cash. The valuation is terminal-heavy by construction: near-term owner FCF is small while the DTC build-out and inventory investment run, and value accrues as growth and the WC drag decelerate. The honest finding is that the market's ~3x ex-Yonghui EV/EBITDA prices the bear path as the base case; the DCF only beats the price if cash conversion recovers.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital capture: at -30% rather than -22% of incremental revenue the owner-FCF ramp is delayed by years; FY2024-25 ran at -31% to -35%.
Directly-operated overseas store economics: S&D rose 39.6% on 22.4% revenue in H1 FY2026; if the margin does not recover the base case EBITDA path is 1.5-2pp too high.
Yonghui stake (RMB7.58bn, 25% of assets, pledged against RMB3.2bn of loans) is marked at a quoted price for a 29% block in a turnaround; a 30% haircut is ~HK$2.2/share.
RMB10.8bn of gross debt-like obligations incl. US$550m ELS due 2032 (USD exposure against CNY flows) and the TOP TOY preferred redemption; dividends and buybacks have been debt-funded.
China consumer demand and the durability of the IP/blind-box cycle driving same-store growth; overseas same-store already negative.
CNY/HKD and USD/CNY: per-share values are in CNY converted at 1.1754; the ELS principal is USD.
Timing: FY2026 is discounted a full year from an October valuation date, ~10 months conservative.
